title: Happy iOS managed app configuration
description: Optional keys in com.apple.configuration.managed; applied at app restart. This documents the dictionary and is not an Intune schema import format.

server_url.description: HTTPS relay origin, optionally with a port or trailing slash. No credentials, path, query or fragment. Overrides local server selection. Whitespace is trimmed by the app.

analytics_enabled.description: False disables PostHog initialization. True or omission respects user opt-out and build disable controls.
